newsitem.title: CHILE: Telecom CTC, VTR merger deal agreed - CTC.
newsitem.headline: Telecom CTC, VTR merger deal agreed - CTC.

text.p: The owners of Chile's largest telecom Compania de Telecomunicaciones de Chile and smaller rival VTR SA have reached agreement on a merger, said CTC president Claudio Garcia.
"I believe that the agreement has already been reached," Garcia told reporters at a trade fair.
Talks on the merger were being carried out between Telefonica de Espana, which owns 43 percent of CTC, and the Luksic group, which controls VTR.
SBC Communications owns 40 percent of VTR. (( -- Rodrigo Martinez, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
